hierarchy.h1: page-title — Fraunces, text-3xl sm:text-4xl, font-medium, ink
hierarchy.money: Fraunces tabular figures. Inflows use money-positive (cyan ink). The brand accent is copper and is not used as the number color.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Existing screen grids stay. Pages sit under a full-width top bar, not a left rail.
spacing_and_layout.page_canvas: Cool mist page. White sheets with a hairline and a short shadow. Modest radius, about 10px.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Fixed top bar: Fraunces wordmark, then a horizontal link row. Active item is an ink label with a copper underline. Mobile uses a left drawer with a copper left rule.

top_nav.item: px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-foreground

inputs.base: bg-card border border-input rounded-xl h-11 px-3.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring/30

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-md h-10 px-4 font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-primary/90
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground rounded-md h-10 px-4 font-medium hover:bg-secondary/80

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Color and shadow only. Cards do not lift.
motion_and_interactions.chart_animations: Thin strokes, soft ink or copper fills, hairline horizontal grid.

components_and_libraries.ui_components: shadcn/ui (Cards, Dialogs, Dropdowns, Tables, Tabs, Slider, Switch, Popover)
components_and_libraries.charts: recharts — ink, copper, slate, and clay. No brand-green series.

instructions_to_main_agent: FlowWise has its own ledger look: cool mist canvas, white sheets, copper for actions, cyan only for positive amounts, Fraunces for titles and money, Outfit for UI.
Navigation is a top bar with a copper underline. Do not switch back to a left sidebar or a filled pill nav.
Do not use a sage or forest green as the brand color, and do not use a warm cream page.
Default to light mode. The Settings toggle remains. Dark mode is ink and copper, not zinc and blue.
Keep every existing screen, route, and data behavior. Do not add features or marketing lines.
Product name stays FlowWise. Interactive elements keep their data-testid attributes.
